title: Artifact: Smaller verified Boolean circuits for SHA-256
description: Circuits, verifier, generators, proof manifests and SAW/Cryptol scripts for the paper "Smaller verified Boolean circuits for SHA-256". Contains three fixed-IV SHA-256 compression circuits (96,273, 96,324 and 100,658 AND+XOR gates, NOT free; also in Bristol Fashion format), a variable-chaining-value SHA-256 circuit and a SHA-1 circuit, the compositional SAT/LRAT verifier with a strict LRAT checker, the twin-cut certificates for linear-layer rewrites, and the SAW proofs linking the verifier's reference to Galois's Cryptol SHA-256 specification. reproduce.sh runs the quick checks in about 7 minutes on a laptop.
